Company Background 
Okta, Inc. (“Okta” or “The Company”) is an independent provider of identity for an enterprise. The Okta 
Identity Cloud enables organizations to secure and manage their extended enterprise and transform 
their customers’ experiences. Okta was founded in 2009 and is based in San Francisco, California.

Potential for Fraud  
Management considers the potential for fraud, which can occur in both financial and non-financial 
reporting, when assessing the risks to Okta’s objectives. The absence of controls, or ineffective 
controls, provides an opportunity for fraud when combined with an incentive to commit fraud. 
Therefore, documented policies and procedures are in place to guide personnel in identifying the
